title: Quickly Seared Korean Chicken Legs Skillet
description: A low-carb, post-workout Korean dish featuring crispy chicken legs, with a nutty flavor, cooked in an iron teppan skillet.
instructions: Heat the iron teppan skillet over high heat until it reaches 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, gochujang, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger to make the marinade.
Add the chicken legs to the marinade and toss to coat, letting it sit for 10 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Add the sesame oil to the preheated skillet and swirl it around to coat the bottom.
Sear the chicken legs in the skillet for 5 minutes on each side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
After searing, immediately submerge the chicken legs in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Once the chicken has cooled, sprinkle the sesame seeds and chopped green onions on top.
Serve the chicken legs hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
